import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def generate_weights(history, universe):
    idx = pd.Index(universe)
    if len(idx) == 0:
        return pd.Series(dtype=float)
    zero = pd.Series(0.0, index=idx, dtype=float)

    ac = history.get('adjusted_close')
    if ac is None:
        ac = history.get('close')
    if ac is None:
        return zero

    n = len(ac.index)
    if n < 30:
        return zero

    reb = ((n - 1) // 5) * 5
    if reb < 25:
        return zero

    cols = [c for c in idx if c in ac.columns]
    if len(cols) == 0:
        return zero

    start = max(0, reb - 44)
    close = ac.iloc[start:reb + 1][cols].astype(float).copy()
    close = close.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    if close.shape[0] < 25:
        return zero

    last = close.iloc[-1]
    valid = last.notna() & (close.notna().sum(axis=0) >= 25)

    ret = close / close.shift(1) - 1.0
    ret = ret.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    vol = ret.iloc[-20:].std(axis=0, ddof=1)
    vol = vol.where(vol > 0, np.nan)

    r5 = close.iloc[-1] / close.iloc[-6] - 1.0
    eps = 1e-8
    score = -r5 / (vol + eps)

    vol_df = history.get('volume')
    if vol_df is not None:
        vcols = [c for c in cols if c in vol_df.columns]
        if len(vcols) > 0:
            vsub = vol_df.iloc[start:reb + 1][vcols].astype(float)
            csub = close[vcols]
            dollar = vsub * csub
            liq = dollar.iloc[-20:].median(axis=0)
            liq = liq.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
            liq = liq.reindex(cols)
            valid = valid & (liq > 0)
            if liq.notna().sum() >= 20:
                thresh = liq.quantile(0.20)
                valid = valid & (liq >= thresh)

    valid = valid & score.notna()
    candidates = [c for c in cols if bool(valid.get(c, False))]
    if len(candidates) < 4:
        return zero

    sc = score.loc[candidates].sort_values(ascending=False)
    k = min(30, len(candidates) // 2)
    if k < 1:
        return zero

    longs = sc.index[:k].tolist()
    shorts = sc.index[-k:].tolist()
    wmag = min(0.5 / k, 0.02)

    w = zero.copy()
    w.loc[longs] = wmag
    w.loc[shorts] = -wmag
    w = w.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0)
    return w

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

_REB = 5          # weekly rebalance (trading days)
_R21 = 21         # reversal formation
_R252 = 252       # momentum formation
_NSIDE = 40       # names per leg
_BUF = 1.6        # no-trade band multiplier on leg size
_TARGET_VOL = 0.12


def _ranks(s):
    out = pd.Series(np.nan, index=s.index, dtype=float)
    d = s.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()
    if len(d) == 0:
        return out
    out.loc[d.index] = d.rank(method='average', pct=True) - 0.5
    return out


def _scores(P, elig_last):
    """Residual 1-month reversal score (reversal orthogonal to 12-1 momentum)."""
    if P.shape[0] < _R252 + 2:
        return None
    last = P.iloc[-1]
    with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
        r21 = last / P.iloc[-1 - _R21] - 1.0
        mom = P.iloc[-1 - _R21] / P.iloc[-1 - _R252] - 1.0
        rets = P.pct_change()
        vol = rets.iloc[-60:].std()
    r21 = r21.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    mom = mom.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    ok = (last.notna() & (last > 0) & r21.notna() & mom.notna()
          & vol.notna() & (vol > 0))
    ok = ok & (P.iloc[-_R252:].notna().mean() > 0.9)
    if elig_last is not None:
        ok = ok & elig_last.reindex(ok.index).fillna(False).astype(bool)
    ok = ok.fillna(False)
    idx = ok[ok].index
    if len(idx) < 20:
        return None
    rev = _ranks(-r21.reindex(idx))
    mo = _ranks(mom.reindex(idx))
    x = mo.values.astype(float)
    y = rev.values.astype(float)
    m = np.isfinite(x) & np.isfinite(y)
    if m.sum() < 10:
        return None
    xm = x[m]
    ym = y[m]
    vx = float(np.var(xm))
    beta = float(np.cov(xm, ym)[0, 1] / vx) if vx > 1e-12 else 0.0
    beta = float(np.clip(beta, -1.5, 1.5))
    resid = (rev - beta * mo).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()
    return resid


def _select(scores, n_side, prev_long, prev_short):
    order = scores.sort_values(ascending=False)
    k = len(order)
    nl = min(n_side, k // 2)
    if nl < 1:
        return [], []
    kbuf = min(k, int(round(nl * _BUF)))
    top = list(order.index[:kbuf])
    bot = list(order.index[-kbuf:][::-1])
    prev_l = set(prev_long)
    prev_s = set(prev_short)
    lc = [t for t in top if t in prev_l] + [t for t in top if t not in prev_l]
    sc = [t for t in bot if t in prev_s] + [t for t in bot if t not in prev_s]
    return lc[:nl], sc[:nl]


def generate_weights(history, universe):
    tickers = pd.Index(list(universe))
    if len(tickers) == 0:
        return pd.Series(dtype=float)
    zeros = pd.Series(0.0, index=tickers, dtype=float)

    px = history.get('adjusted_close')
    if px is None:
        return zeros
    px = px.reindex(columns=tickers).astype(float)
    px = px.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    n = px.shape[0]
    if n < _R252 + 3:
        return zeros

    reb = n - 1 - ((n - 1) % _REB)
    if reb < _R252 + 1:
        return zeros

    elig = history.get('eligible')
    e = None
    if elig is not None:
        e = elig.reindex(columns=tickers)

    P = px.iloc[:reb + 1]
    e_cur = None
    if e is not None and e.shape[0] > reb:
        e_cur = e.iloc[reb].fillna(False).astype(bool)
    scores = _scores(P, e_cur)
    if scores is None:
        return zeros

    prev_long, prev_short = [], []
    prev_reb = reb - _REB
    if prev_reb >= _R252 + 1:
        Pprev = px.iloc[:prev_reb + 1]
        e_prev = None
        if e is not None and e.shape[0] > prev_reb:
            e_prev = e.iloc[prev_reb].fillna(False).astype(bool)
        s_prev = _scores(Pprev, e_prev)
        if s_prev is not None:
            prev_long, prev_short = _select(s_prev, _NSIDE, [], [])

    longs, shorts = _select(scores, _NSIDE, prev_long, prev_short)
    nl = len(longs)
    ns = len(shorts)
    if nl < 1 or ns < 1:
        return zeros

    base_w = min(0.02, 0.5 / float(max(nl, ns)))

    w = pd.Series(0.0, index=tickers, dtype=float)
    w.loc[list(longs)] = base_w
    w.loc[list(shorts)] = -base_w

    # volatility targeting on the proposed book (60-day window)
    scale = 1.0
    try:
        rets = P.pct_change().iloc[-60:]
        nz = w[w != 0.0]
        sub = rets.reindex(columns=nz.index).fillna(0.0)
        port = sub.mul(nz, axis=1).sum(axis=1)
        sd = float(port.std(ddof=0))
        if np.isfinite(sd) and sd > 1e-8:
            vol_ann = sd * np.sqrt(252.0)
            scale = float(np.clip(_TARGET_VOL / vol_ann, 0.35, 1.0))
    except Exception:
        scale = 1.0

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

_REB = 5          # weekly rebalance (trading days)
_R21 = 21         # reversal formation
_R252 = 252       # momentum formation
_NSIDE = 40       # names per leg
_BUF = 1.6        # no-trade band multiplier on leg size
_TARGET_VOL = 0.12


def _ranks(s):
    out = pd.Series(np.nan, index=s.index, dtype=float)
    d = s.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()
    if len(d) == 0:
        return out
    out.loc[d.index] = d.rank(method='average', pct=True) - 0.5
    return out


def _scores(P, elig_last):
    """Residual 1-month reversal score (reversal orthogonal to 12-1 momentum)."""
    if P.shape[0] < _R252 + 2:
        return None
    last = P.iloc[-1]
    with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
        r21 = last / P.iloc[-1 - _R21] - 1.0
        mom = P.iloc[-1 - _R21] / P.iloc[-1 - _R252] - 1.0
        rets = P.pct_change()
        vol = rets.iloc[-60:].std()
    r21 = r21.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    mom = mom.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    ok = (last.notna() & (last > 0) & r21.notna() & mom.notna()
          & vol.notna() & (vol > 0))
    ok = ok & (P.iloc[-_R252:].notna().mean() > 0.9)
    if elig_last is not None:
        ok = ok & elig_last.reindex(ok.index).fillna(False).astype(bool)
    ok = ok.fillna(False)
    idx = ok[ok].index
    if len(idx) < 20:
        return None
    rev = _ranks(-r21.reindex(idx))
    mo = _ranks(mom.reindex(idx))
    x = mo.values.astype(float)
    y = rev.values.astype(float)
    m = np.isfinite(x) & np.isfinite(y)
    if m.sum() < 10:
        return None
    xm = x[m]
    ym = y[m]
    vx = float(np.var(xm))
    beta = float(np.cov(xm, ym)[0, 1] / vx) if vx > 1e-12 else 0.0
    beta = float(np.clip(beta, -1.5, 1.5))
    resid = (rev - beta * mo).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()
    return resid

    order = scores.sort_values(ascending=False)
    k = len(order)
    nl = min(n_side, k // 2)

    n = len(ac.index)
    period = 15
    if n < 80:
        return zero

    reb = ((n - 1) // period) * period
    if reb < 60:
        return zero

    cols = [c for c in idx if c in ac.columns]
    if len(cols) == 0:
        return zero

    lookback = 90
    start = max(0, reb - lookback + 1)
    close = ac.iloc[start:reb + 1][cols].astype(float).copy()
    close = close.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    if close.shape[0] < 70:
        return zero

    last = close.iloc[-1]
    valid = last.notna() & (close.notna().sum(axis=0) >= 60)

    ret = close / close.shift(1) - 1.0
    ret = ret.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    vol = ret.iloc[-60:].std(axis=0, ddof=1)
    vol = vol.where(vol > 1e-6, np.nan)

    horizons = [5, 10, 21]
    scores = []
    for h in horizons:
        if close.shape[0] <= h:
            continue
        r = close.iloc[-1] / close.iloc[-1 - h] - 1.0
        r = r.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        rv = r.where(valid & r.notna())
        if rv.notna().sum() < 10:
            continue
        mu = rv.mean(skipna=True)
        resid = r - mu
        scores.append(-resid / (vol + 1e-8))

    if not scores:
        return zero

    score = pd.concat(scores, axis=1).mean(axis=1, skipna=True)
    score = score.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    vol_df = history.get('volume')
    if vol_df is not None and not vol_df.empty:
        vcols = [c for c in cols if c in vol_df.columns]
        if len(vcols) > 0:
            vsub = vol_df.iloc[start:reb + 1][vcols].astype(float)
            csub = close[vcols]
            dollar = vsub * csub
            liq = dollar.iloc[-60:].median(axis=0)
            liq = liq.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).reindex(cols)
            valid = valid & (liq > 0)
            if liq.notna().sum() >= 20:
                thresh = liq.quantile(0.30)
                valid = valid & (liq >= thresh)

    elig_df = history.get('eligible')
    if elig_df is not None and not elig_df.empty:
        try:
            row = elig_df.iloc[reb] if reb < len(elig_df) else elig_df.iloc[-1]
            row = row.reindex(cols).fillna(False).astype(bool)
            valid = valid & row

            ln = [c for c in longs if c in w.index and w.loc[c] > 0.0]

    if gross > 1.0:
        w = w * (1.0 / gross)
    return w

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

_REB = 5          # weekly rebalance (trading days)
_R21 = 21         # reversal formation
_R252 = 252       # momentum formation
_NSIDE = 40       # names per leg
_BUF = 1.6        # no-trade band multiplier on leg size
_TARGET_VOL = 0.12


def _ranks(s):
    out = pd.Series(np.nan, index=s.index, dtype=float)
    d = s.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()
    if len(d) == 0:
        return out
    out.loc[d.index] = d.rank(method='average', pct=True) - 0.5
    return out


def _scores(P, elig_last):
    """Residual 1-month reversal score (reversal orthogonal to 12-1 momentum)."""
    if P.shape[0] < _R252 + 2:
        return None
    last = P.iloc[-1]
    with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
        r21 = last / P.iloc[-1 - _R21] - 1.0
        mom = P.iloc[-1 - _R21] / P.iloc[-1 - _R252] - 1.0
        rets = P.pct_change()
        vol = rets.iloc[-60:].std()
    r21 = r21.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    mom = mom.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    ok = (last.notna() & (last > 0) & r21.notna() & mom.notna()
          & vol.notna() & (vol > 0))
    ok = ok & (P.iloc[-_R252:].notna().mean() > 0.9)
    if elig_last is not None:
        ok = ok & elig_last.reindex(ok.index).fillna(False).astype(bool)
    ok = ok.fillna(False)
    idx = ok[ok].index
    if len(idx) < 20:
        return None
    rev = _ranks(-r21.reindex(idx))
    mo = _ranks(mom.reindex(idx))
    x = mo.values.astype(float)
    y = rev.values.astype(float)
    m = np.isfinite(x) & np.isfinite(y)
    if m.sum() < 10:
        return None
    xm = x[m]
    ym = y[m]
    vx = float(np.var(xm))
    beta = float(np.cov(xm, ym)[0, 1] / vx) if vx > 1e-12 else 0.0
    beta = float(np.clip(beta, -1.5, 1.5))
    resid = (rev - beta * mo).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()
    return resid


def _select(scores, n_side, prev_long, prev_short):
    order = scores.sort_values(ascending=False)
    k = len(order)
    nl = min(n_side, k // 2)
    if nl < 1:
        return [], []
    kbuf = min(k, int(round(nl * _BUF)))
    top = list(order.index[:kbuf])
    bot = list(order.index[-kbuf:][::-1])
    prev_l = set(prev_long)
    prev_s = set(prev_short)
    lc = [t for t in top if t in prev_l] + [t for t in top if t not in prev_l]
    sc = [t for t in bot if t in prev_s] + [t for t in bot if t not in prev_s]
    return lc[:nl], sc[:nl]


def generate_weights(history, universe):
    tickers = pd.Index(list(universe))
    if len(tickers) == 0:
        return pd.Series(dtype=float)
    zeros = pd.Series(0.0, index=tickers, dtype=float)

    px = history.get('adjusted_close')
    if px is None:
        return zeros
    px = px.reindex(columns=tickers).astype(float)
    px = px.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    n = px.shape[0]
    if n < _R252 + 3:
        return zeros

    reb = n - 1 - ((n - 1) % _REB)
    if reb < _R252 + 1:
        return zeros

    elig = history.get('eligible')
    e = None
    if elig is not None:
        e = elig.reindex(columns=tickers)

    P = px.iloc[:reb + 1]
    e_cur = None
    if e is not None and e.shape[0] > reb:
        e_cur = e.iloc[reb].fillna(False).astype(bool)
    scores = _scores(P, e_cur)
    if scores is None:
        return zeros

    prev_long, prev_short = [], []
    prev_reb = reb - _REB
    if prev_reb >= _R252 + 1:
        Pprev = px.iloc[:prev_reb + 1]
        e_prev = None
        if e is not None and e.shape[0] > prev_reb:
            e_prev = e.iloc[prev_reb].fillna(False).astype(bool)
        s_prev = _scores(Pprev, e_prev)
        if s_prev is not None:
            prev_long, prev_short = _select(s_prev, _NSIDE, [], [])

    longs, shorts = _select(scores, _NSIDE, prev_long, prev_short)
    nl = len(longs)
    ns = len(shorts)
    if nl < 1 or ns < 1:
        return zeros

    base_w = min(0.02, 0.5 / float(max(nl, ns)))

    w = pd.Series(0.0, index=tickers, dtype=float)
    w.loc[list(longs)] = base_w
    w.loc[list(shorts)] = -base_w

    # volatility targeting on the proposed book (60-day window)
    scale = 1.0
    try:
        rets = P.pct_change().iloc[-60:]
        nz = w[w != 0.0]
        sub = rets.reindex(columns=nz.index).fillna(0.0)
        port = sub.mul(nz, axis=1).sum(axis=1)
        sd = float(port.std(ddof=0))
        if np.isfinite(sd) and sd > 1e-8:
            vol_ann = sd * np.sqrt(252.0)
            scale = float(np.clip(_TARGET_VOL / vol_ann, 0.35, 1.0))
    except Exception:
        scale = 1.0

    w = w * scale
    w = w.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0)
    return w.reindex(tickers).fillna(0.0)

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

_REB = 12
_FORM = 21
_NLONG = 40
_BUF = 2.0
_TARGET_VOL = 0.10
_MIN_HIST = 130
_MAX_W = 0.02
_GROSS_LIMIT = 1.0


def _zeros(tickers):
    return pd.Series(0.0, index=tickers, dtype=float)


def _scores(P, elig_last, form):
    n = P.shape[0]
    if n < form + 2:
        return None
    last = P.iloc[-1]
    ret = last / P.iloc[-1 - form] - 1.0
    ret = ret.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    rets = P.pct_change()
    vol = rets.iloc[-120:].std()
    hist_ok = P.iloc[-120:].notna().mean() > 0.8
    valid = last.notna() & (last > 0) & ret.notna() & vol.notna() & (vol > 0) & hist_ok
    if elig_last is not None:
        valid = valid & elig_last.reindex(valid.index).fillna(False).astype(bool)
    valid = valid.fillna(False)
    idx = valid[valid].index
    if len(idx) < 2:
        return None
    score = -ret.reindex(idx)
    score = score.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()
    return score


def _select(scores, n_long, prev_long):
    if scores is None or len(scores) < 2:
        return []
    order = scores.sort_values(ascending=False)
    k = len(order)
    n = min(n_long, k - 1)
    if n < 1:
        return []
    kbuf = min(k, int(round(n * _BUF)))
    top = list(order.index[:kbuf])
    prev_set = set(prev_long) if prev_long is not None else set()
    keep = [t for t in top if t in prev_set]
    new = [t for t in top if t not in prev_set]
    return (keep + new)[:n]


def _compute_target_weights(reb, px, elig, tickers):
    P = px.iloc[:reb + 1]
    e_cur = None
    if elig is not None and elig.shape[0] > reb:
        e_cur = elig.iloc[reb].reindex(tickers).fillna(False).astype(bool)
    scores = _scores(P, e_cur, _FORM)
    if scores is None:
        return _zeros(tickers), []

    prev_long = []
    prev_reb = reb - _REB
    if prev_reb >= _MIN_HIST:
        Pprev = px.iloc[:prev_reb + 1]
        e_prev = None
        if elig is not None and elig.shape[0] > prev_reb:
            e_prev = elig.iloc[prev_reb].reindex(tickers).fillna(False).astype(bool)
        s_prev = _scores(Pprev, e_prev, _FORM)
        if s_prev is not None:
            prev_long = _select(s_prev, _NLONG, [])

    longs = _select(scores, _NLONG, prev_long)
    if len(longs) < 1:
        return _zeros(tickers), []

    if e_cur is not None:
        short_ok = e_cur.copy()
    else:
        short_ok = pd.Series(True, index=tickers)
    last = P.iloc[-1]
    short_ok = short_ok & last.notna() & (last > 0)
    short_ok = short_ok & (P.iloc[-20:].notna().mean() > 0.8)
    short_ok = short_ok.fillna(False)
    long_set = set(longs)
    short_universe = [t for t in tickers if short_ok.get(t, False) and t not in long_set]

    n_long = len(longs)
    n_short = len(short_universe)
    if n_long < 1 or n_short < 1:
        return _zeros(tickers), []

    base_L = min(0.4, _MAX_W * n_long, _MAX_W * n_short)
    if base_L <= 0:
        return _zeros(tickers), []

    w = _zeros(tickers)
    w.loc[longs] = base_L / n_long
    w.loc[short_universe] = -base_L / n_short

    rets = px.pct_change().iloc[:reb + 1].iloc[-120:]
    nz = w[w != 0.0]
    if len(nz) > 0:
        sub = rets.reindex(columns=nz.index).fillna(0.0)
        port = sub.mul(nz, axis=1).sum(axis=1)
        sd = float(port.std(ddof=0))
        vol_ann = sd * np.sqrt(252.0) if np.isfinite(sd) else np.nan
    else:
        vol_ann = np.nan

    if np.isfinite(vol_ann) and vol_ann > 1e-8:
        vol_scale = _TARGET_VOL / vol_ann
    else:
        vol_scale = 1.0
    vol_scale = float(np.clip(vol_scale, 0.2, 1.25))

    max_base_w = max(base_L / n_long, base_L / n_short)
    scale_weight = _MAX_W / max_base_w if max_base_w > 0 else 1.0
    scale_gross = _GROSS_LIMIT / (2.0 * base_L) if base_L > 0 else 1.0
    final_scale = min(vol_scale, scale_weight, scale_gross)
    final_scale = max(final_scale, 0.0)

    w = w * final_scale
    w = w.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0)
    return w, longs


def generate_weights(history, universe):
    tickers = pd.Index(list(universe))
    if len(tickers) == 0:
        return pd.Series(dtype=float)
    zeros = _zeros(tickers)

    px = history.get('adjusted_close')
    if px is None:
        return zeros
    px = px.reindex(columns=tickers).astype(float)
    px = px.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    n = px.shape[0]
    if n < _MIN_HIST:
        return zeros

    elig = history.get('eligible')
    if elig is not None:
        elig = elig.reindex(columns=tickers)

    reb = n - 1 - ((n - 1) % _REB)
    if reb < _MIN_HIST:
        return zeros

    w_reb, longs = _compute_target_weights(reb, px, elig, tickers)
    if w_reb is None or w_reb.abs().sum() == 0:
        return zeros

    if n - 1 == reb:
        return w_reb.reindex(tickers).fillna(0.0)

    t = n - 1
    w = w_reb.copy()
    nz = w[w != 0.0].index
    if len(nz) == 0:
        return zeros

    P_reb = px.iloc[reb]
    P_t = px.iloc[t]
    R = (P_t / P_reb - 1.0).reindex(nz).fillna(0.0)
    R_p = float((w.loc[nz] * R).sum())
    if not np.isfinite(R_p) or abs(1.0 + R_p) < 1e-8:
        return w_reb.reindex(tickers).fillna(0.0)

    w_drift = w.copy()
    w_drift.loc[nz] = w.loc[nz] * (1.0 + R) / (1.0 + R_p)

    net = float(w_drift.sum())
    if abs(net) > 0.01:
        pos = w_drift[w_drift > 0]
        neg = w_drift[w_drift < 0]
        if len(pos) > 0 and len(neg) > 0:
            long_sum = float(pos.sum())
            short_sum = float(-neg.sum())
            L = 0.5 * (long_sum + short_sum)
            if long_sum > 0 and short_sum > 0:
                w_drift.loc[pos.index] = w_drift.loc[pos.index] * (L / long_sum)
                w_drift.loc[neg.index] = w_drift.loc[neg.index] * (L / short_sum)

    max_abs = float(w_drift.abs().max()) if len(w_drift) > 0 else 0.0
    if max_abs > _MAX_W and max_abs > 0:
        w_drift = w_drift * (_MAX_W / max_abs)

    gross = float(w_drift.abs().sum())
    if gross > _GROSS_LIMIT and gross > 0:
        w_drift = w_drift * (_GROSS_LIMIT / gross)

    w_drift = w_drift.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0)
    return w_drift.reindex(tickers).fillna(0.0)

                w.loc[grp] = w.loc[grp] - s * (w.loc[grp] / tot)
    else:
        grp = [c for c in shorts if float(w.get(c, 0.0)) < 0.0]
        if grp:
            tot = float(-w.loc[grp].sum())
            if tot > 0.0:
                w.loc[grp] = w.loc[grp] - (s * (-w.loc[grp] / tot))
    return w


def generate_weights(history, universe):
    idx = pd.Index(universe)
    if len(idx) == 0:
        return pd.Series(dtype=float)
    zero = pd.Series(0.0, index=idx, dtype=float)

    ac = history.get('adjusted_close')
    if ac is None or ac.empty:
        ac = history.get('close')
    if ac is None or ac.empty:
        return zero

    n = len(ac.index)
    period = 15
    if n < 120:
        return zero
    reb = ((n - 1) // period) * period
    if reb < 110:
        return zero

    cols = [c for c in idx if c in ac.columns]
    if len(cols) < 40:
        return zero

    lookback = 130
    start = max(0, reb - lookback + 1)
    close = ac.iloc[start:reb + 1][cols].astype(float)
    close = close.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    if close.shape[0] < 100:
        return zero

    last = close.iloc[-1]
    valid = last.notna() & (close.notna().sum(axis=0) >= 100)
    if int(valid.sum()) < 30:
        return zero

    ret = close.pct_change()
    ret = ret.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    vol = ret.iloc[-60:].std(axis=0, ddof=1)
    vol = vol.where(vol > 1e-6, np.nan)

    med_vol = vol[valid].median()
    if pd.notna(med_vol) and float(med_vol) > 0.0:
        valid = valid & (vol <= 3.0 * float(med_vol))

    horizon_w = [(5, 0.25), (10, 0.30), (21, 0.45)]
    num = pd.Series(0.0, index=cols, dtype=float)
    den = pd.Series(0.0, index=cols, dtype=float)
    for h, wgt in horizon_w:
        if close.shape[0] <= h + 1:
            continue
        r = close.iloc[-1] / close.iloc[-1 - h] - 1.0
        r = r.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        mask = valid & r.notna()
        if int(mask.sum()) < 20:
            continue
        mu = float(r[mask].mean())
        resid = r - mu
        s = -resid / (vol + 1e-8)
        s = s.where(mask)
        num = num.add((s * wgt).fillna(0.0))
        den = den.add(pd.Series(float(wgt), index=cols).where(s.notna(), 0.0))

    den = den.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    score = num / den
    score = score.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    vol_df = history.get('volume')
    if vol_df is not None and not vol_df.empty:
        vcols = [c for c in cols if c in vol_df.columns]
        if len(vcols) > 0:
            vsub = vol_df.iloc[start:reb + 1][vcols].astype(float)
            vsub = vsub.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
            vsub = vsub.reindex(columns=cols)
            dollar = vsub * close
            liq = dollar.iloc[-60:].median(axis=0)
            liq = liq.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
            valid = valid & (liq > 0.0)
            if int((liq[valid].notna()).sum()) >= 30:
                thresh = float(liq[valid].quantile(0.30))
                valid = valid & (liq >= thresh)

    elig_df = history.get('eligible')
    if elig_df is not None and not elig_df.empty:
        try:
            dt = ac.index[reb]
            if dt in elig_df.index:
                row = elig_df.loc[dt]
            else:
                row = elig_df.iloc[min(reb, len(elig_df) - 1)]
            row = row.reindex(cols).fillna(False).astype(bool)
            valid = valid & row
        except Exception:
            pass

    valid = valid & score.notna() & np.isfinite(score)
    candidates = [c for c in cols if bool(valid.get(c, False))]
    if len(candidates) < 40:
        return zero

    sc = score.loc[candidates].sort_values(ascending=False)
    k = min(70, len(candidates) // 2)
    if k < 20:
        return zero

    longs = sc.index[:k].tolist()
    shorts = sc.index[-k:].tolist()
    wmag = min(0.02, 0.98 / (2.0 * k))

    w = zero.copy()
    w.loc[longs] = wmag
    w.loc[shorts] = -wmag

    w = _neutralize(w, longs, shorts)
    w = w.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0).clip(-0.02, 0.02)

    gross = float(w.abs().sum())
    if gross > 0.98 and gross > 0.0:
        w = w * (0.98 / gross)
    w = w.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0).clip(-0.02, 0.02)
    return w
